description: This PHP source file defines the ChatbotClient class for the AWS SDK, which interacts with the chatbot service. It contains method annotations for various operations related to chatbot configurations, channels, and resources.

classes.name: ChatbotClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Chatbot service, extending the base AwsClient class.

methods.name: associateToConfiguration
methods.description: Associates the chatbot with a specified configuration.

methods.name: associateToConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates the chatbot with a configuration.

methods.name: createChimeWebhookConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a webhook configuration for Amazon Chime.

methods.name: createChimeWebhookConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a Chime webhook configuration.

methods.name: createCustomAction
methods.description: Creates a custom action for the chatbot.

methods.name: createMicrosoftTeamsChannelConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a channel configuration for Microsoft Teams.

methods.name: createMicrosoftTeamsChannelConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a Microsoft Teams channel configuration.

methods.name: createSlackChannelConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a Slack channel configuration.

methods.name: deleteChimeWebhookConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a Chime webhook configuration.

methods.description: Deletes a Microsoft Teams channel configuration.

methods.name: deleteMicrosoftTeamsChannelConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a Microsoft Teams channel configuration.

methods.name: deleteMicrosoftTeamsConfiguredTeam
methods.description: Deletes a configured Microsoft Teams team.

methods.name: deleteMicrosoftTeamsConfiguredTeamAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a configured Microsoft Teams team.

methods.name: deleteMicrosoftTeamsUserIdentity
methods.description: Deletes a Microsoft Teams user identity.

methods.name: deleteMicrosoftTeamsUserIdentityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a Microsoft Teams user identity.

methods.name: deleteSlackChannelConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a Slack channel configuration.

methods.name: deleteSlackUserIdentityAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a Slack user identity.

methods.name: disassociateFromConfiguration
methods.description: Disassociates the chatbot from a configuration.

methods.description: Asynchronously disassociates the chatbot from a configuration.

methods.name: getCustomAction

methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves information about a custom action.

methods.description: Retrieves a Microsoft Teams channel configuration.

methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a Microsoft Teams channel configuration.
